name: Staff outcome resolver (a filed staff finding's GitHub issue closes as merged, rejected or noise; demote on overrule, propose promotions and noise suppressions)

knobs.note: BH-5563: 0 stops every resolver run after the kill-flag check and before any read. Read by bin/staff-outcomes.sh as ${STAFF_OUTCOMES_ENABLED:-1}; out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-5563: GitHub issue reads per run. At the cap the cursor (state/staff-outcomes/cursor) is saved at the last id read and the next run goes on from there; at the end of the list it goes back to 0.

BH-5563: the issue label that makes a closed staff issue `noise` (exact match after trim and lowercase; it wins over a completed close). Noise feeds a suppression proposal, so it must be an explicit label.
Test seam: a file bin/staff-outcomes.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/staff-outcomes.sh sources STAFF_OUTCOMES_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
